title: Separuh Masa Neraka
notes: Source of truth for Episode 11 (rework). Besi Waja's machine football: Malik speaks in commands, and the referee books AZAM — the card whose fine plus bank charge pushes the debt to RM305,000. Locker-room despair goes deeper (Farid, Danial), and the armband scene finally breathes: Bos explains the wait, Azam confesses his guilt, Bos explains why guilt is the point. Cliffhanger on the armband going on.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Mesin & Kad Kuning
scenes.visual: Hook: the referee flashes a yellow card straight into the lens. Besi Waja play like a machine; Kapten Malik commands in three-word bursts. The card is AZAM's — and the league fine plus bank charge it triggers (+RM5,000) is his guilt to carry. MatchHUD advances 0-1 (24') -> 0-2 (41') -> 0-2 (HT).
scenes.sfx: whistle + card flash at 0; kick + net on both conceded goals; crowd murmur.

events.note: First cut within the hook window.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Besi Waja. Tak kalah satu pun. Datang nak tanam kita.
lines.translation: Besi Waja. Undefeated. Here to bury us.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Hampir lima ribu sebab kad aku. Maaf, bos.
lines.translation: Almost five grand over my card. I am sorry, boss.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Bilik Ganti Sunyi
scenes.visual: The 5-3-2 whiteboard untouched, heads down, flickering lights. Farid says the thing nobody wants to admit — this team cannot beat Besi Waja without Karim. Danial is hollowed out. Azam refuses to let the room die, seconds before the door opens and Bos walks in without a word.
scenes.sfx: door open; flickering-lamp buzz; low tense drone; one bass-hit on the door.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Bilik ganti sunyi. Baju basah. Lampu berkelip.
lines.translation: The locker room is silent. Wet kits. Flickering lights.

lines.speaker: FARID
lines.text: Kita tak boleh lawan diorang tanpa Karim.
lines.translation: We cannot beat them without Karim.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Karim dah pergi. Kita masih kena berdiri.
lines.translation: Karim is gone. We still have to stand.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.translation: The door opens. The boss walks in. Silence.

scenes.name: Act 3 — Armband (Kovenan Diteruskan)
scenes.visual: Bos pulls Karim's gold armband from his pocket — the same armband he swore over in Episode 6. He explains the wait; Azam confesses the yellow card; Bos explains why guilt is exactly why he chose him. The handover lands, the armband goes on, hard cut. No narrator in this act.
scenes.sfx: quiet room tone; soft fabric rustle on the handover; one warm bell as the band is worn.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Karim tinggal armband ni. Aku tunggu siapa layak.
lines.translation: Karim left this armband. I waited to see who deserves it.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Azam. Hari ni kau kapten Buluh FC.
lines.translation: Azam. Today you are the captain of Buluh FC.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Kad kuning aku tadi hampir tenggelamkan kita.
lines.translation: My yellow card almost sank us today.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Sebab tu aku pilih kau. Yang rasa berat takkan silap.
lines.translation: That is why I chose you. The one who feels the weight never errs.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Gaji aku lima ringgit. Baju ni aku jaga sampai mati.
lines.translation: My salary is five ringgit. This shirt I guard till I die.

scenes.name: Buluh FC Series Outro
scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 11 card. No CTA.
